feature: Each row of the / command list wears its own icon
summary: Typing / in Ask lists commands, and every row now shows an icon for that command (scissors for Split, a diamond for Key at Playhead, the edge for each Align row) instead of one icon per area.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/ask-slash-lists-commands-walk.json.

try.do: Open a picture, draw a rectangle and leave it picked.
try.shotNote: The mock (agent-generate-wt.html, the / list): one icon per row.
Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Type al after the slash and look at the Align rows.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Type /track in a video and scan the track rows (Add Video Track, Mute Track, Lock Track).
Press the down arrow a few times and Return to run a row.

evaluate: Can you tell what a row does from its icon before reading its words?
Do any two neighbouring rows look so alike that the icons stop helping?
Does any icon say the wrong thing about its command?
The icons are the Mac's own symbols, like every other icon in the app, not the mock's drawn glyphs: is that right for this list?
rough: Rows that are one choice of a command (Speed 50%, a transition kind) wear their command's icon; only Align and Space Evenly rows show their own choice.

The shared mock's Ask dialog still drew a New conversation button the user took out on 2026-11-04; it is removed from the shared mock component (your call on 2026-11-04, one-agent-pane-on-the-right-a-plain-history-of-r).
